writers.name: sync-qbo
writers.notes: Source at supabase/functions/sync-qbo/. Writes qbo_token_cache via lease RPC ops.qbo_token_claim_refresh(). v40 (2026-05-28) populates qbo_invoices.invoice_payment_url with Invoice.InvoiceLink via per-invoice read with ?include=invoiceLink&minorversion=70; surfaces to brix-order /invoices/:id 'Pay now' CTA.

writers.name: sync-qbo-items
writers.schedule: nightly 09:30 UTC + on-demand from Margin UI
writers.notes: Populates purchase_cost which powers est_cost / est_margin in v_sales_lines. Uses lease RPC for token refresh. Cron defined in 20260503r_nightly_sync_crons.sql.

writers.name: sync-qbo-customers
writers.notes: Cron defined in 20260503r_nightly_sync_crons.sql. Writes the upstream customer record (display_name, addresses, etc.). Geocode columns (lat/lon/geocoded_at/geocode_status) are managed by the geocode-customers function.

writers.name: geocode-customers
writers.schedule: nightly 10:30 UTC (cron geocode-customers-nightly, max=80 per run)
writers.notes: Source at supabase/functions/geocode-customers/. Populates qbo_customers.lat/lon for the cohort: active + has billing address + (billed in last 90 days OR is the Alameda depot at '1951 Monarch'). Idempotent — skips already-geocoded rows unless qbo_updated_at advances. ~440-row backfill takes ~6 nightly runs (max=80 keeps each call under the 150s idle timeout). Drives auto-geofence stop attribution in sync-fleetcomplete (mode=trips). Cron in 20260509e.

writers.name: sync-fleetcomplete
writers.schedule: every 5 min latest-snapshots (cron fleetcomplete-latest-snapshots); hourly :05 roster — vehicles + people + geofences (cron fleetcomplete-roster); daily 09:00 UTC trips + driver-events (cron fleetcomplete-trips)
external_inputs: Unity by Powerfleet GraphQL API at api.fleetcomplete.com
writers.notes: Source at supabase/functions/sync-fleetcomplete/. Modes: vehicles, latest, people, geofences, trips IMPLEMENTED. fuel NOT POSSIBLE via Unity (no fuel-card API). maintenance BLOCKED upstream (getWrappedReport php-exception). mode=trips walks getSnapshots over the last 26 h, reconstructs trips by ignition cycle, extracts driverBehaviour events into fleet_driver_events, and matches each stop (≥5 min dwell) to the nearest geocoded qbo_customer within 200 m → fleet_stop_visits. Fleet page in the SPA exposes Map / Trips / Stops / Drivers / Safety tabs. Cron schedule defined in 20260508b + 20260509c.

writers.name: brix-expense:app-and-functions
writers.schedule: on-demand (user submits expense / manager approves / link-bill)
writers.notes: Brixpense surface (app-expense/ Vite SPA at /expense/ + netlify/functions/expense-request-* + expense-to-bill + process-inbound). Frontend uses anon key under permissive RLS (submitters INSERT/UPDATE own rows; anon SELECT/UPDATE gated on approval_token presence for the magic-link approval page). Netlify functions use the anon key bound to the user JWT or service role for cross-cutting status transitions, approval logging, and QBO bill creation. expense_settings is read by useExpenseSettings(); seeded by 20260512_create_expense_tables.sql (auto_approve_threshold + approval_email) and finished by 20260512p_expense_cleanup.sql (cogs_accounts + manager_emails + tags + corrected departments).

writers.name: brix-stock:app-and-rpcs
writers.notes: BRIX Stock surface (app/src/pages/stock/) writes via ops.fn_create_transfer / fn_ship_transfer / fn_receive_transfer / fn_void_transfer (all SECURITY DEFINER, authenticated only). inventory_movements is append-only via those RPCs; clients never INSERT directly. inventory_locations is directly writable from the UI under permissive RLS (low volume CRUD; virtual TRANSIT and ADJUSTMENT rows are protected by a kind-NOT-IN check in the update policy). Phase 1 only emits transfer_ship and transfer_receive movement types; Phase 4 will add receipt (from bills) and shipment (from invoices). See architecture/PRODUCT-CONTROL.md for the full design. Migration: 20260513a_inventory_stock.sql.

writers.name: qbo-pos-import
writers.schedule: on-demand (operator clicks 'Pull POs from QBO' in the Margin Production tab)
writers.notes: Mirrors QBO-direct PurchaseOrders into shadow tables so the inventory On Order column (fn_items_master.on_order CTE) counts POs that were never created through BRIX. Per-PO picker modal in app/src/pages/production/QboPosPickerModal.tsx. Bearer-only auth (any logged-in @brixbev.com employee can preview + import). Upserts headers by qbo_id; lines are replaced wholesale on each import. De-dup with ops.purchase_orders.qbo_purchase_order_id so a BRIX-native PO pushed to QBO isn't counted twice. Migration: 20260516b_qbo_purchase_orders_shadow.sql.
